title: Only allow refunds for successfully captured payments
intent: Add refund support for successfully captured payments — a refund should only be possible against a payment that was actually captured.
acceptance_criteria: Requesting a refund against a FAILED payment is rejected with a clear conflict error
Requesting a refund against a CAPTURED payment still succeeds within the captured amount
Existing excessive-refund and duplicate-refund rejection behavior is unaffected
expected_risks: RefundService.create_refund already validates the refund amount against the running total — this task adds the missing payment.status == CAPTURED check alongside it
expected_tests: refund against a failed payment is rejected
refund against a captured payment still succeeds (regression)
expected_failure_modes: create_refund validates only the amount, not payment.status (current gap)
